stories.title: LPG'ye dev zam: Fiyatlar 40 TL'yi aştı

en.title: Major increase in LPG: Prices exceed 40 TL
en.summary: LPG prices rose for a second time within 24 hours, following an increase of 1.45 lira on October 1st, with new rates taking effect at midnight.

stories.title: Son Dakika: Soma'dan acı haberler geliyor. Ölü sayısı 5’e çıktı

en.title: Breaking: Tragic news from Soma. Death toll rises to 5
en.summary: A mine collapse at a private mining operation in Soma, Manisa resulted in multiple fatalities, with the death toll reaching five.

stories.title: Süper Lig Hakemi Yasin Kol gözaltına alındı

en.title: Super Lig Referee Yasin Kol detained
en.summary: Super Lig referee Yasin Kol was taken into custody as part of an investigation conducted against the Central Refereeing Board.

stories.title: Fon dolandırıcılığı “şüphelisi” SPK eski başkanı ifade verdi: İbrahim Bey bizimle dalga mı geçiyor?

en.title: Fund fraud "suspect" former SPK chief gives statement: Is Ibrahim Bey mocking us?
en.summary: The Capital Markets Board announced compensation terms for fund fraud victims, with those investing under 1 million TL receiving full principal repayment and those above that amount receiving maximum 1 million TL.

en.title: New Opening
en.summary: President Erdoğan engaged in informal conversation with members of parliament who greeted him upon his arrival at the assembly.

en.title: 'We Face Organized Crime'
en.summary: The leader of the Good Party stated that Turkey is confronting what he described as the largest robbery in the nation's republican history.

en.title: Bread Produced by Students Sold to Bakeries!
en.summary: Thousands of loaves of bread produced by students at a vocational school in Kırşehir were sold to bakeries.

stories.title: Fon vurgununda bir AKP’li daha: Reklamcı, eski vekil

en.title: Another AKP Member in Fund Embezzlement: Advertiser, Former Deputy
en.summary: A third person has been connected to a fund embezzlement case following a former minister and a party vice chairperson, identified as an advertiser and former member of parliament.

stories.title: Evlat kudretli çıkınca tedbir 1 saatte kalktı

en.title: Measure lifted in 1 hour after influential son emerged
en.summary: A precautionary measure was quickly reversed within an hour after a prominent figure's son, including the child of an AKP heavyweight Hayati Yazıcı, became involved in a fund-related incident affecting assets.

stories.title: Kritik bürokrat SÖZCÜ’ye olayın perde arkasını anlattı: Kimler kimler baskı yapmadı ki

en.title: Critical bureaucrat explains to SÖZCÜ the backstory of the incident: Who didn't apply pressure
en.summary: Bureaucrats and politicians supported Tera Group's acquisition of Doğa Insurance, while only the regulatory authority SEDDK opposed the transaction.

stories.title: Sosyal medyadaki görüntü polisi harekete geçirdi: Tüfekle dolaşan 17 yaşındaki genç yakalandı

en.title: Social media image prompts police action: 17-year-old carrying rifle apprehended
en.summary: Police in Bursa's Orhangazi district arrested a 17-year-old who was walking the streets with an air rifle in a case after images were shared on social media.

en.title: Suspect carrying rifle on street apprehended
en.summary: In Bursa's Orhangazi district, a suspect was caught carrying a rifle on the street and detained with an air rifle.

stories.title: ABD Körfez’e askeri yığınağı büyütüyor: Petrol yeniden 102 doların üzerinde

en.title: US increases military buildup in Gulf: Oil rises above 102 dollars
en.summary: The US is preparing to send a third aircraft carrier group and thousands of additional troops to the Middle East, raising risk premiums in energy markets. Brent crude oil remains above 102 dollars as attention turns to potential developments regarding Iran.

en.title: Fed signals new interest rate increase
en.summary: The Dallas Federal Reserve President stated that additional interest rate increases are needed to bring inflation to target levels. The tightening in the bond market could influence the magnitude of any future increases.

stories.title: Motorinde yeni kriz: ABD Avrupa’dan 120 milyon varil rezerv istedi

en.title: New diesel crisis: US requests 120 million barrels of reserves from Europe
en.summary: Facing supply tightness in global diesel markets, the US has requested France and Germany release 120 million barrels of emergency diesel reserves within six months. The US is considering limiting exports if demand cannot be met.

stories.title: Altında faiz baskısı büyüdü: Bugün dengeler değişebilir

en.title: Gold faces interest rate pressure: Balances could shift today
en.summary: Gold is heading toward a second weekly loss as rising US dollar strength and bond yields increase downward pressure. Upcoming US employment data could significantly alter Federal Reserve rate expectations and gold's direction.

stories.title: İran: Hürmüz Boğazı'nda son günlerde hedef alınan 3 petrol tankeri BAE bağlantılı

en.title: Iran: 3 oil tankers targeted recently in Strait of Hormuz linked to UAE
en.summary: Iran's maritime authority stated that three oil tankers recently targeted in the Strait of Hormuz have connections to the United Arab Emirates.
